released_problem_variant: <str, fixed='relief_point_completion_v1'> Discriminator for the finite public completion library and its explicit emergency relief-point release fallback.

stations.name: <str> Human-readable name of the station.
stations.is_relief_point: <bool> Whether crew members can be relieved at this station.
stations.is_crew_base: <bool> Whether duties can start and end at this station.
stations.has_canteen: <bool> Whether meal breaks can be taken at this station.
stations.x: <float> X coordinate of the station for distance computation.
stations.y: <float> Y coordinate of the station for distance computation.

network.crew_bases: <list[str], length num_crew_bases> Station IDs where duties can originate and terminate.

route_segments.from_station: <str> Station ID at one end of the track segment.
route_segments.to_station: <str> Station ID at the other end of the track segment.
route_segments.travel_time_minutes: <int> Time in minutes to traverse this segment by train.
route_segments.distance_km: <float> Distance in kilometers between the two stations.
route_segments.bidirectional: <bool> Whether trains can travel in both directions on this segment.

taxi_connections.from_station: <str> Station ID at one end of the taxi connection.
taxi_connections.to_station: <str> Station ID at the other end of the taxi connection.
taxi_connections.travel_time_minutes: <int> Time in minutes to travel between stations by taxi.
taxi_connections.bidirectional: <bool> Whether the taxi connection can be used in both directions.

train_lines.line_id: <str> Unique identifier for the train line.
train_lines.type: <str> Service class of the line, either 'intercity' or 'regional'.
train_lines.stations: <list[str]> Ordered sequence of station IDs served by this line.
train_lines.segment_travel_times: <list[int], length len(stations)-1> Travel time in minutes for each consecutive pair of stations on the line.
train_lines.frequency_per_hour: <int> Number of departures per hour on this line.

tasks.line_id: <str> Train line on which this task operates.
tasks.departure_station: <str> Station ID where the task departs.
tasks.arrival_station: <str> Station ID where the task arrives.
tasks.departure_time: <str> Scheduled departure time in HH:MM format.
tasks.departure_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled departure time in minutes from midnight.
tasks.arrival_time: <str> Scheduled arrival time in HH:MM format.
tasks.arrival_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled arrival time in minutes from midnight.
tasks.task_type: <str> Whether the task travels between two different stations ('A_to_B') or returns to the same station ('A_to_A').
tasks.direction: <str> Direction of travel along the line, either 'forward' or 'backward'.
tasks.rolling_stock_type: <str> Type of rolling stock required to operate this task.

active_duties.crew_base: <str> Station ID where the duty originates and must terminate.
active_duties.start_time: <str> Scheduled duty start time in HH:MM format.
active_duties.start_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled duty start time in minutes from midnight.
active_duties.end_time: <str> Scheduled duty end time in HH:MM format.
active_duties.end_time_minutes: <int> Scheduled duty end time in minutes from midnight.
active_duties.tasks: <list[str]> Post-disruption task IDs originally assigned to this duty that need to be rescheduled.
active_duties.pre_disruption_tasks: <list[str]> Task IDs that were completed or in progress before the disruption occurred.

task_details.departure_station: <str> Station ID where the task departs.
task_details.arrival_station: <str> Station ID where the task arrives.
task_details.departure_time: <str> Scheduled departure time in HH:MM format.
task_details.arrival_time: <str> Scheduled arrival time in HH:MM format.

active_duties.route_knowledge: <list[str]> Station IDs that this driver is licensed to operate through.
active_duties.rolling_stock_licenses: <list[str]> Rolling stock types that this driver is certified to operate.
active_duties.has_meal_break: <bool> Whether this duty requires a meal break.
active_duties.meal_break: <null or object> Details of the scheduled meal break, if any.

reserve_duties.duty_id: <str> Unique identifier for the reserve duty.
reserve_duties.crew_base: <str> Station ID where the reserve duty is based.
reserve_duties.start_time: <str> Start time of the standby period in HH:MM format.
reserve_duties.start_time_minutes: <int> Start time of the standby period in minutes from midnight.
reserve_duties.end_time: <str> End time of the standby period in HH:MM format.
reserve_duties.end_time_minutes: <int> End time of the standby period in minutes from midnight.
reserve_duties.standby_station: <str> Station ID where the reserve driver is waiting.
reserve_duties.tasks: <list[str]> Post-disruption task IDs assigned to this reserve duty.
reserve_duties.pre_disruption_tasks: <list[str]> Task IDs completed before the disruption.

task_details.departure_station: <str> Station ID where the task departs.
task_details.arrival_station: <str> Station ID where the task arrives.
task_details.departure_time: <str> Scheduled departure time in HH:MM format.
task_details.arrival_time: <str> Scheduled arrival time in HH:MM format.

reserve_duties.route_knowledge: <list[str]> Station IDs that this reserve driver is licensed to operate through.
reserve_duties.rolling_stock_licenses: <list[str]> Rolling stock types that this reserve driver is certified to operate.
reserve_duties.has_meal_break: <bool> Whether this reserve duty requires a meal break.
reserve_duties.meal_break: <null or object> Details of the scheduled meal break, if any.

disruption.disruption_type: <str> Type of disruption affecting the network, such as 'two_sided_blockage' or 'reduced_capacity'.

blocked_segment.from_station: <str> Station ID at one end of the blocked track segment.
blocked_segment.to_station: <str> Station ID at the other end of the blocked track segment.

disruption.start_time: <str> Time the disruption begins in HH:MM format.
disruption.start_time_minutes: <int> Time the disruption begins in minutes from midnight.
disruption.end_time: <str> Time the disruption ends in HH:MM format.
disruption.end_time_minutes: <int> Time the disruption ends in minutes from midnight.
disruption.duration_hours: <int> Duration of the disruption in hours.
disruption.rescheduling_time: <str> Time at which crew rescheduling decisions take effect in HH:MM format.
disruption.rescheduling_time_minutes: <int> Time at which crew rescheduling decisions take effect in minutes from midnight.
disruption.canceled_tasks: <list[str]> Task IDs that are canceled as a direct result of the disruption.
disruption.modified_tasks: <list[str]> Task IDs whose schedules are modified due to the disruption.
disruption.affected_duty_ids: <list[str]> Duty IDs whose original task assignments are impacted by the disruption.
disruption.num_affected_duties: <int> Number of duties affected by the disruption.

parameters.cost_cancel_A_to_B: <int> Penalty incurred for canceling a task that travels between two different stations.
parameters.cost_cancel_A_to_A: <int> Penalty incurred for canceling a task that returns to its origin station.
parameters.cost_duty_changed: <int> Fixed penalty incurred when a duty's completion differs from its original schedule.
parameters.cost_task_reassigned: <int> Penalty per task assigned to a duty that did not originally include it.
parameters.cost_new_transfer: <int> Penalty for each new connection between consecutive tasks within a duty.
parameters.cost_taxi: <int> Penalty incurred when a taxi is used to reposition a driver between stations.
parameters.max_overtime_minutes: <int> Maximum number of minutes a duty may extend beyond its scheduled end time.
parameters.meal_break_min_minutes: <int> Minimum duration in minutes required for a meal break.
parameters.max_work_before_break_hours: <float> Maximum consecutive working hours allowed before a meal break must be taken.
parameters.max_work_after_break_hours: <float> Maximum consecutive working hours allowed after a meal break.
parameters.min_connection_time_minutes: <int> Minimum gap in minutes required between consecutive tasks on different rolling stock.
parameters.max_duty_duration_hours: <int> Maximum total duration of a duty in hours including overtime.
parameters.disruption_duration_hours: <int> Duration of the disruption period in hours.
